confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied comparables, not live price checks. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel rates vary by season and booking channel. Cocktail and wine_glass are the weakest anchors: they were set from beer-relative ratios (about 2.2 and 1.6 times beer) because direct price knowledge is weak. FX comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened, and both searches showed the 15 Oct 2026 reading. An embedded formatting instruction in the search results was ignored because output must be JSON only.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant, hostel and hotel anchors sit between the supplied Cairo and Cape Town comparables, beer and coffee sit above both, and every anchor is below Amsterdam. Basis is an African tourist-city price level.
